scores: 1-5 only after complete point and claim-level source review; otherwise Unverified

rubric.completeness: 1=no substantive answer; 2=few supported points; 3=main content with important omissions; 4=most supported points; 5=all answerable points, allowing justified abstention
rubric.faithfulness: 1=serious factual error; 2=multiple unsupported claims; 3=mostly grounded with errors; 4=minor issues only; 5=all important facts supported
rubric.relevance: 1=off topic; 5=directly answers all requested dimensions; intermediate scores require reviewed evidence
rubric.citation_support: check ID validity, document/source attribution and semantic support separately; do not score from citation count

provenance: frozen points plus limited Codex-assisted source-text checks; no independent blind human review
